_comment: Edit this file and re-run: node scripts/import-event.mjs scripts/data/technova.json. Matching is by event title, so re-running updates rather than duplicates.

event.title: TECHNOVA — The Freshers' Technical Quiz
event.description:
A PIXEL initiative to welcome the new batch through knowledge, technology, teamwork and healthy competition.

Four rounds of increasing difficulty, from general knowledge and current affairs through to advanced technical and analytical questions.
eligibility: Valid student ID required at check-in
rules: Participants must arrive 30 minutes before the event starts.
Each team may submit only one answer per question.
Use of phones or external assistance during a round is prohibited.
Negative marking applies in every round — see the scoring table.
The organising team's decision on scoring is final.

quiz.title: TECHNOVA Round 1 — The Spark
quiz.description: Screening round. General knowledge, current affairs, basic technical and logical reasoning.

questions.text: Which protocol is primarily used for secure web communication?
Which algorithm is used to train most modern neural networks?
What does SQL injection primarily exploit?
Which data structure works on Last In, First Out?
In machine learning, what problem does overfitting describe?
options: The model is too simple for the data
The model memorises training data and generalises poorly
The dataset is too large to process
Training takes too long to converge
questions.correctAnswer: The model memorises training data and generalises poorly
